sets.desc: It typically refers to the navigation elements used to indicate the current position within the carousel and to provide direct access to any slide/item. These controls are located usually below the carousel content.

sets.name: Carousel Arrows
sets.desc: It consists of left and right directional arrows placed on either side of the carousel content. These arrows allow users to manually cycle through the carousel items by clicking or tapping on them.
